title: Thyristor Rectifier Voltage Controller (Three-Phase)
text: 晶闸管整流器的离散时间直流母线电压 PI 控制，输入 4 路、输出 1 路；{Loop filter proportional gain} 指定环路滤波器 K p、{Loop filter integral gain} 指定环路滤波器 K i、{Proportional gain} 控制器 K p、{Integral gain} 控制器 K i、{Thyristor pulse width (rad)} 指定脉冲宽度 5*pi/6、{Pulse ordering} 指定脉冲排序规则 Sequential device、{Sample time (-1 for inherited)} 指定模块采样时间、{Time constant voltage filter} 指定直流电压滤波器 τ、{Filter DC voltage} 指定直流电压滤波器，按实例取值。

params.name: Loop filter proportional gain
params.values: 环路滤波器 K p 2 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Loop filter integral gain
params.values: 环路滤波器 K i 20 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Proportional gain
params.values: 控制器 K p 1 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Integral gain
params.values: 控制器 K i 1 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Pulse ordering
params.values: 脉冲排序规则 Sequential device order (default) | Natural order of commutation

params.name: Sample time (-1 for inherited)
params.values: 模块采样时间 -1 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Time constant voltage filter
params.values: 直流电压滤波器 τ 0.001 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Filter DC voltage
params.values: 直流电压滤波器选项 on (default) | off
